traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Olacaceae, which takes in Schoepfiaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire; veins single or pinnate; stipules absent; plants hermaphrodite, monoecious or dioecious; ovary usually superior, sometimes half inferior; floral cup present or absent; stems woody; flowers in panicles, in racemes or in heads, rarely solitary; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit drupe or nut; stamens 3 to 18; carpels (2-) 3 (-5). Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
